title: Squared² Ui
description: This changes the Ui to be more Squared rather than Rounded.
body:
# Squared² Ui
You would think a game being about squares would have a squared Ui but you're wrong, Minecraft's ui is rounded in most areas of the game. This Resource Pack changes all Vanilla Ui to have a more Squared Look rather than Rounded Corners to match the Squared feeling of Minecraft.

Left is Squared² | Right is Vanilla

(More in Gallery)

![Inv Compare](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f6cfe1dd3f30530985177645becba7d86bde852.png)
